response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM manager_award GROUP BY player_id), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM c) SELECT c.player_id, c.cnt AS award_count, CASE WHEN t.total IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE c.cnt * 1.0 / t.total END AS fraction FROM c CROSS JOIN t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
